framing.commercialQuestion: Is enterprise laptops in Singapore worth VAIO pursuing, and which segment gives the best chance of a defensible margin?
framing.narrative: VAIO Singapore is exploring enterprise laptops as a go-to-market category. Before committing sales effort, we need a numerical view of where real bulk demand sits — not just a qualitative read — and explicit assumptions wherever public data is incomplete.

scaleDimension.name: Employee size band
scaleDimension.description: Proxy for fleet/deal scale — how many laptops a single account could plausibly buy.

source.value: MOM parliamentary reply on SME size distribution + Apollo employee-size filtering for the two largest bands

profileDimension.name: Industry
profileDimension.description: Used only to infer the dominant workforce/workload profile and therefore likely laptop need — not a direct headcount-to-laptop translation.

source.value: SingStat 2024 services industry statistics (Public Administration excluded from source)

fitFilterDimension.name: Laptop price cluster
fitFilterDimension.description: A positive/negative filter against VAIO's product line, not additive market size.
